messages:
Aisha S.: seeing a sustained tail-latency + token egress spike on dedicated slab-42 since ~03:40 UTC. A few tenants showing 3x token rate and KV-cache miss storms. any quick wins?
Tom B.: can you paste a sample p99 and the tenant ids?
Aisha S.: p99-> 450ms -> 1.8s over last 30m. affected tenants: tenant-514, tenant-922, tenant-legacy-3. logs: 
```
2026-03-19T03:41:12Z slab-42 kube-proxy: net_queue_drop 120
2026-03-19T03:41:13Z runtime: kvcache_evictions=4325 miss_rate=0.67
2026-03-19T03:41:14Z infer: token_outbound_rate=8200 r/s
```
Ruan L.: looks like KV cache thrash + egress bursts. could be warmup loops from tenant-legacy-3 (they've got a heavy sampling job). Might be causing PCIe stalls downstream.
InfraBot: autoscaler note: slab-42 is at 92% GPU util, cannot autoscale due to reserved dedicated carveouts.
Evelyn M.: temporary mitigations: 1) soft-throttle tenant-legacy-3 burst credits 2) enable per-tenant KV cache partitioning (config flag: `runtime.kvcache.partition=true`) 3) move critical latency tenants to hot-slice if available.
Ben C.: I can carve out a 2-GPU hot-slice and pin tenant-514 + tenant-922 for 30m. propose: drain tenant-legacy-3 from slab-42 -> move to burst pool, reduce its burst window to 10s. anyone object?
Tom B.: +1. also set proxy egress shaping for slab-42 to 1Gbps per-tenant cap while we observe. quick patch: 
```
kubectl patch configmap egress-shaper -n infra --patch '{"data":{"slab-42":"tenant=1g;default=500m"}}'
```
Aisha S.: applying egress patch now, carving hot-slice (Ben), and toggling kvcache.partition. will post telemetry in 5m.
InfraBot: deploybot: rollout of egress-shaper patch started (id: rb-20260319-1843).
Ruan L.: if this keeps reoccurring we should add adaptive burst-priority decay: reduce burst credits automatically on sustained miss_rate>0.5 for 2m. avoids manual ops.
Evelyn M.: agree. add to backlog: eval cost impact of per-tenant kvcache (memory increase) vs egress shaping (bandwidth cost).
Ben C.: done — tenants pinned, legacy moved. monitoring looks better so far :eyes:.
Aisha S.: p99 down to ~220ms after 6m. keeping this thread open for 30m to confirm stability. thanks all :thumbsup:
